newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain subdued ahead of Whitsun.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain subdued ahead of Whitsun.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained subdued ahead of the three-day Whitsun weekend in most of Europe with only one trade reported, dealers said.
Spot Thai tapioca traded at 19.50 marks per 100 kg fob Amsterdam.
"It was a dull day. There was no faith in the market. A weaker Chicago soycomplex futures also kept a lid on activity," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
